title: Implement Decapod client path for Propodus Vercel todo API (#766)
intent: Add the smallest optional cloud client boundary for Propodus's current Go/Vercel todo API, with typed request/response/error models, local fake-server proof, unchanged offline SQLite defaults, and no provider-specific auth or Rust Propodus dependency.
stop_conditions: Do not reintroduce the Propodus Rust crate, add live credentials, or mutate .decapod state directly.
